Reuters (scraped, pub 14:39 BST): funeral events begin this weekend; mosque Saturday, Tehran procession Monday, Qom Tuesday, Najaf/Kerbala Wednesday, burial Thursday 9 July Mashhad near Imam Reza shrine. Family killed in same 28 Feb strike carried alongside. Qom Friday prayer leader Ayatollah Mohammad Saidi: turnout 'will, in effect, be another referendum for the Islamic Republic'. Russia/China dignitaries at Friday condolences; airspace restrictions; Mojtaba (wounded) not seen in new imagery since war began. Corroborated: AP Hormuz article confirms funeral timing.
